Exact Stop-Loss & Price-Triggered Re-Entry Architecture (Per-Leg State Machine)

Reference Anchor: Original Entry Premium P0 (NOT Index Spot)
1 Initial Sell Entry
Sell Option @ P0 (e.g. ₹100)

Leg set to ACTIVE. Calculate initial stop trigger: P0 × (1 + SL%) = ₹130 (30% SL) or ₹140 (40% SL).

2 Stop-Loss Exit
Premium reaches SL Trigger

Trigger buy exit on executable quotes (handling gap slippage). Record actual exit fill. State → SL_EXITED.

3 Monitor Same Strike
Track Contract & Quotes

Do not require a new prediction. Continuous watchdog monitors live bid/ask quotes for the exact same strike.

4 Price-Triggered Re-Entry
Premium ≤ P0 (e.g. ≤ ₹100)

Submit new sell order. Strictly 1 re-entry per cycle. New SL trigger = Actual Re-entry Fill × (1 + SL%). State → RE_ENTERED.

5 Final Exit / MOC Decay
Final SL or 15:25 MOC

If re-entered leg hits new SL → FINAL_SL_EXITED (no more re-entries). Else hold into afternoon theta decay for full credit.
